Jordyn Hermani (🔈: "Her Min E”) (@JordynHermani)

Michigan Sen. Mallory McMorrow —  who’s running for Michigan’s open U.S. Senate seat — just finished speaking, and immediately chants of “ABDUL, ABDUL” break out. 

This was the response from the crowd when Abdul El-Sayed, also a Democratic US Senate candidate, took the stage.
